Subject: Need help with a wrongful termination case

Hello, my name is Rahul Desai. I am a 73-year-old government clerk living in Mangaluru. My employer Sterling Pharma Ltd owes me 41.7 lakh rupees after firing me, and the employer offered to settle. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 06160474649 or email rahul.desai27@example.in.
